meaning.stateAsIndexed: Original documented state in its own source/scope; no historical states overwritten.
meaning.unknown: No reusable value in that indexed scope; not proof it never exists elsewhere. Three already-published other-scope values are explicitly linked.
meaning.partial: Source value in limited scope; not a request for complete unit inventory or proof of all filter combinations.
meaning.layers: Published, preparedLeben and local24a are separate; no union or borrowed facts.
